14. In view of the aforesaid circumstances, and the fact that the parties have put a quietus to the dispute, no useful purpose will be served in continuing with the present FIR No. 597/2022, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at P.S. Madhu Vihar.
15. In the interest of justice, the petition is allowed, and the FIR No. 597/2022, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at P.S. Madhu Vihar, is hereby quashed.
